Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

during preposition

also in the course of, at dinner, in the night, in summer, throughout

classical

Cato Agr. 37: per hiemem lūcubrātiōne haec facitō
Sen. Ep. 104.24: multa per noctem habita terrōrī

per + acc.

preposition with the accusative

during, throughout

For what goes on through the time.

Other words

  • cāsus ablātīvus — in, during (the time when)

    construction: the time in the ablative, with no preposition · also used · classical · Mart. 10.62.12: aestāte puerī sī valent, satis discunt; Cic. Q. fr. 3.1.3: locum aestāte umbrōsiōrem

    The plain answer to “when?”: hieme, aestāte, nocte, eō diē; “by night” is noctū.

  • inter + acc. — during (a meal, a game, an activity)

    preposition with the accusative, often of a gerund · also used · classical · Cic. Q. fr. 3.1.19: haec inter cēnam Tīrōnī dictāvī; Quint. 1.3.12: inter lūdendum; Traupman 298; Traupman 307

    inter cēnandum, during dinner.

  • in + abl. — during, on (a journey, a party)

    preposition with the ablative · also used · classical · Cato Agr. 156.1: in convīviō; Deut. 6.7: ambulāns in itinere

    in itinere, on the way; in convīviō, at a party.

Examples

  • per hiemem lūcubrātiōne haec facitō

    do these jobs by lamplight during the winterCato Agr. 37

  • multa per noctem habita terrōrī diēs vertit ad rīsum

    much that frightened us during the night, the day turns into a laughSen. Ep. 104.24

  • aestāte puerī sī valent, satis discunt

    in summer, if children are well, they learn enoughMart. 10.62.12

  • haec inter cēnam Tīrōnī dictāvī, nē mīrēre aliā manū esse

    I dictated this to Tiro during dinner, so don’t be surprised that it is in another handCic. Q. fr. 3.1.19

  • mōrēs quoque sē inter lūdendum simplicius dētegunt

    character, too, shows itself more openly during playQuint. 1.3.12

  • et narrābis ea fīliīs tuīs, et meditāberis in eīs sedēns in domō tuā, et ambulāns in itinere, dormiēns atque cōnsurgēns

    and you shall tell them to your children, and think on them as you sit in your house and as you walk on the way, as you lie down and as you riseDeut. 6.7

See also for, until.
